title: Accounts Payable
description:
Accounts Payable Assistant - Temporary

Location: Hemel Hempstead

Contract: Temporary

We are recruiting for an experienced Accounts Payable Assistant to join a busy finance team in Hemel Hempstead on a temporary basis.

This is a hands-on transactional finance role, supporting the day to day running of the purchase ledger and ensuring supplier invoices and payments are processed accurately and on time.

The Role
- Processing high volumes of supplier invoices, ensuring accuracy and correct authorisation.
- Matching invoices to purchase orders and delivery documentation.
- Investigating invoice discrepancies, price differences and missing information.
- Reconciling supplier statements and resolving outstanding queries.
- Managing supplier accounts and responding to payment and invoice enquiries.
- Preparing supplier payment runs and assisting with payment processing.
- Posting invoices, credit notes and adjustments onto the finance system.
- Supporting month-end procedures, including purchase ledger reconciliations and accruals.
- Maintaining accurate supplier records and ensuring invoices are properly documented.
- Providing general support to the wider finance team when required.

About You
- Previous experience working within a busy Accounts Payable or Purchase Ledger function.
- Confident processing supplier invoices and reconciling supplier statements.
- Good understanding of purchase ledger processes.
- Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
- Comfortable investigating discrepancies and dealing with supplier queries.
- Confident using Excel and finance systems.
- Able to work independently, manage workloads and meet deadlines.
- Available to start a temporary assignment at short notice.

The Opportunity

An excellent opportunity for an immediately available Accounts Payable professional looking to join a busy finance team and make an immediate contribution.

title: Contracts Administrator
description:
Contracts Administrator

Location: Hemel Hempstead
Salary: 13.33 per hour ( 26,436.80 per annum)
Hours: Monday to Friday, 8.00am - 4.30pm
Contract: Temporary to Permanent - 12 weeks temporary with the opportunity to secure a permanent contract.

This role is fully office based in Henel Hempstead.

Our client, a dynamic and fast-paced organisation, is looking for an organised and customer-focused Contracts Administrator to join their team in Hemel Hempstead.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced administrator who enjoys working in a busy environment, has great attention to detail and takes pride in delivering outstanding customer service.

title: Customer Service & Logistics Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Customer Service & Logistics Coordinator

Location: Hemel Hempstead, HP2
Pay Rate: 15.75 per hour
Contract Type: 12-Month (Full-Time)
Hours: Monday - Friday, 37.5 hours per week

The Opportunity
Are you an organised administrator with a knack for keeping orders moving and customers happy? We are recruiting on behalf of a leading global business in Hemel Hempstead (HP2) for a Customer Service & Logistics Coordinator to join their EMEA operations team on a 12-month contract.

In this varied, fast-paced role, you will be the vital link between customers, logistics partners, and internal sales and finance teams across the UK, Ireland, the Netherlands, and Finland.

What you'll be doing
- Order & Logistics Management: Process customer orders and purchase orders from start to finish, liaising with third-party logistics providers to track deliveries and spare parts.
- Customer & Team Support: Act as a key point of contact via phone and email for external customers as well as internal Sales, Finance, and Field Service teams.
- Supply Chain & Stock: Monitor back orders with the supply chain team and update annual customer pricelists on the system.
- Contracts & Queries: Manage annual service contract renewals, resolve invoice queries, and handle customer complaints in line with ISO quality standards.
- Compliance & Documentation: Send out technical product safety documentation (Certificates of Analysis and Safety Data Sheets) and log regulatory field notices when required.

What we're looking for
- Previous experience in customer service, sales order processing, supply chain, or logistics administration.
- Strong IT skills, particularly with ERP/CRM systems and Microsoft Excel, with high attention to detail for data entry and pricing.
- Clear, confident communication skills to coordinate across international teams and resolve queries calmly.
- A degree or equivalent qualification is preferred, though strong relevant industry experience is equally valued.
- Bonus: Any exposure to ISO quality processes, international shipping, or technical/scientific product documentation is a great advantage.

title: Operations Coordinator
salary_text: £28000 - £29000 per year (Hybrid working, progression and more)
description:
Operations Coordinator - Hemel Hempstead

13.95 per hour + holiday pay Weekly Pay Hybrid Working Temp-to-Perm Opportunity

Are you a customer-focused administrator who enjoys problem-solving, keeping things organised and making sure everything runs smoothly?

Think Specialist Recruitment is working exclusively with a local client in Hemel Hempstead to recruit an Operations Coordinator to join their extremely busy and growing team.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an expanding business in a varied role combining customer service, administration, technical support coordination and scheduling. Initially offered on a temporary basis, there is the potential for the position to become permanent for the right person.

You'll be joining a collaborative team where no two days are quite the same, playing an important role in keeping operations running efficiently, supporting field-based engineers and ensuring customer queries are dealt with promptly and professionally.

The best bit? You don't need to come from a technical background. If you have strong customer service and administration experience, enjoy learning new systems and are confident juggling multiple priorities, this could be an excellent next step in your career.

What will you be doing?

You'll act as a key point of contact for technical support queries, coordinating tickets, liaising with engineers and keeping customers and internal teams updated throughout the process.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing support tickets: Raising, updating, prioritising and escalating tickets to ensure issues are dealt with efficiently.
- Coordinating engineers: Allocating tickets to the appropriate departments and field-based engineers across the UK, taking location and requirements into account.
- Supporting customers: Responding to queries, providing accurate updates and managing expectations throughout the resolution process.
- Working with suppliers: Building and maintaining strong working relationships with external vendors.
- Monitoring live issues: Monitoring unit feeds, identifying potential problems and supporting troubleshooting activities.
- Reporting and administration: Maintaining daily reports, updating documentation and ensuring records remain accurate and up to date.
- Keeping operations moving: Working closely with engineers and internal teams to resolve issues, manage priorities and deliver excellent service.

What are we looking for?

We're looking for someone who is proactive, organised and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change throughout the day.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience in customer service and administration - both are essential.
- Strong IT skills and the ability to pick up new systems and processes quickly.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Good attention to detail and strong organisational skills.
- The ability to multitask, prioritise effectively and remain calm under pressure.
- A customer-first mindset and a practical approach to problem-solving.
- Commercial awareness and the confidence to use your own initiative.

Experience that would really make you stand out:
- Working within an operations, service delivery or technical support team.
- Using ticketing or helpdesk systems.
- Coordinating schedules, appointments or field-based engineers.

Don't worry if you haven't worked in every one of these areas before. If you have the right customer service and administrative foundations, a willingness to learn and the ability to keep things organised, we'd love to hear from you.

What's in it for you?
- 13.95 per hour + holiday pay, with weekly pay while temping.
- Equivalent to approximately 29,000 per year on a full-time basis.
- A genuine temporary-to-permanent opportunity.
- Flexible and hybrid working available during the temporary assignment.
- The opportunity to join a growing business with exciting expansion plans.
- Varied responsibilities and the chance to develop new operational and technical skills.

If you move into a permanent position, the additional benefits include:
- Salary of up to 29,000, depending on experience.
- 26 days' annual leave, plus the option to purchase additional days.
- Healthcare plan.
- Enhanced parental leave.
- Volunteering days.
- Opportunities for career progression and further development.

Working hours

The team operates Monday to Friday, with shifts on either:
- 8:30am-5:30pm, or
- 9:00am-6:00pm.

Both shifts include a one-hour lunch break.

The role is based in Hemel Hempstead, with flexible and hybrid working available.

Interested? Let's talk!

If you're looking for a role that offers more variety than a traditional administration position, enjoy helping people and want the opportunity to develop your career within a growing operations team, this could be the perfect fit.

Apply today or contact Think Specialist Recruitment to find out more. We're working exclusively with this client, so we're happy to talk you through the opportunity and what they're looking for.

About Think Specialist Recruitment

Think Specialist Recruitment is an independent recruitment agency based in Hemel Hempstead, supporting businesses and candidates across Hertfordshire, Bedfordshire and Buckinghamshire.

We specialise in permanent, temporary and contract recruitment across administration, customer service, HR, accountancy and finance, sales support, marketing and IT support.

title: HR Administrator

We are happy to discuss alternative working patterns, provided that Thursday is one of your working days. In return, you will receive a competitive salary plus benefits . About the role Your responsibilities will include: To support the HR team in delivering an efficient and effective service. To provide exceptional coordination of the HR streams, with a focus on recruitment, compliance, training, and payroll. To support all administration of the HR service including updating databases, preparing documentation, supporting projects, and ensuring personal files are updated and maintained appropriately Candidates are requested to submit an addendum to their CV that outlines how they meet the criteria specified in the person specification. Meeting all criteria is not required, as training will be provided to the successful candidate. We are looking for someone with strong organisational skills, a proactive and flexible approach, the ability to learn quickly, a commitment to continuous learning, and an interest in HR. To support all administration of the HR service including updating databases, preparing documentation, supporting projects, and ensuring personal files are updated and maintained appropriately. About Us At One Stop Healthcare, we’re more than a private hospital — we’re a team of people united by one shared purpose: to enrich healthcare - for our patients, our people and our community. Based in Hemel Hempstead, we bring together world-class expertise with cutting-edge medical technology to offer a wide range of services under one roof, including GP, dental, physiotherapy, diagnostic imaging and day surgery, making high-quality care more connected and accessible for everyone. What truly sets us apart is how we care. As a people business, the patient is at the heart of everything we do. We take pride in being there for our patients and each other: in person, in time and on site. We build real relationships, take the initiative, and always act with compassion and integrity. Before we do anything, you will always find us safe, proactive and personal — these are the foundations we are built on. Working with us means joining a growing, forward-thinking organisation that values people as much as technology. You’ll be part of a supportive, collaborative team where every role matters, and every idea is heard. Together, we’re shaping a more dependable, dynamic, and personal approach to private healthcare – 7 days a week, 365 days a year. If this sounds like the place where you can bring your best, we’d love to hear from you. For full details, please refer to the job description and person specification attached. Benefits we offer We are dedicated to making a positive impact on the lives of those around us – for our staff as well as our patients. To deliver outstanding healthcare our staff are one of the most important factors in our success. We recognise that what’s important in work goes far beyond pay – including the environment you work in, the people you work with and the benefits and opportunities that come as part of a total reward package. We are committed to enabling you to do the job you have been trained for in a superb environment with the best facilities and equipment available. We want our team to feel valued and have the opportunity to develop and grow with us, so we offer balanced rewards to support your current and future career. Benefits include: 33 days annual leave inc of bank holidays, increasing with length of service and opportunity buy/sell leave (pro-rata for part-time staff) Contributory pension scheme Life Insurance Private Medical Insurance (upon completion of probationary period) Contribution towards Eye Care Cycle to Work Scheme Employee Assistance OSH Discount Discounted Cinema Tickets Car Discounts Free on-site parking Applicants must have the right to work in the UK. Please be advised that if you are invited to attend an interview, you will be required to provide proof of your right to work in the UK. Please note - this role does not qualify for Certificate of Sponsorship. The closing date for applications is 16/12/26 however, please note that we may close the advert earlier if there is a significant number of applications. Click apply today to be considered for the HR Administrator role – we would love to hear from you!
